authorityRef: project owner instruction in the active user request
ruleRef: PROJECT_INTENT.md § Non-goals; original boundary against universal CUDA 13 feature restoration
reason: The project owner clarified that restoring newer CUDA feature semantics on deprecated GPUs is the central goal, including software-emulated paths; deprecation alone must not exclude a feature.
scope: Update project intent and architecture to pursue semantics-compatible restoration of newer CUDA features on older GPUs.
Treat physical-capability absence as a candidate for software emulation and measure its costs.
Retain evidence-backed boundaries where behavior cannot be reproduced; do not claim arbitrary precompiled binary compatibility or performance parity.
allowedEffects: E1 local edits to project intent and architecture documents.
E1 local work-item planning and implementation within explicitly scoped work items.
evidenceRequired: Each feature claim must link to implementation and correctness evidence.
Software emulation must report resource/performance impact separately from correctness.
